description: This file defines the interface for an Epoll class used for managing epoll-based I/O event notification, including class and method declarations, as well as associated data structures and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: Epoll
classes.description: A class encapsulating epoll-based event monitoring, providing methods to add, modify, delete, and wait for events on file descriptors.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create and initialize an Epoll instance, returning a Result wrapping the Epoll object.

methods.name: Epoll
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes an invalid Epoll instance.

methods.name: Epoll
methods.description: Move constructor for transferring ownership of resources.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Move assignment operator for Epoll instances.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to the epoll watch set with specified events.

methods.name: Modify
methods.description: Modifies the event mask for a watched file descriptor.

methods.name: AddOrModify
methods.description: Adds or modifies a file descriptor in the watch set.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor from the watch set.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for events on the watched file descriptors and returns an optional EpollEvent.
